fullContentHtml:
NICL Administrative Officers AO Online Form 2026 – Full Details

National Insurance Company Limited (NICL) has released the notification for the post of Administrative Officers AO. This recruitment has been issued for 321 posts. The online application process for NICL Administrative Officers AO Recruitment 2026 has started on 08 October 2026, and candidates can apply till 28 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NICL Administrative Officers AO Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 07 October 2026
  • Application Start Date : 08 October 2026
  • Last Date : 28 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 October 2026
  • Phase I Exam Date : 17 November 2026
  • Phase I Exam Date : 22 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
